annotations.title: Search BC Accredited Vocational Training Programs

description: Search accredited vocational, diploma, and certificate training programs offered by BC career colleges by keyword or category (e.g., Health Care Assistant, Early Childhood Education, Practical Nursing, IT, Electrician). Use this tool when a user asks about program tuition ranges, duration, StudentAid BC designation, or where to study a specific trade/career in BC. Returns up to 12 matching programs with school name, city, duration, tuition range, and direct URLs.

city.description: Optional BC city filter to narrow results to local campuses (e.g., 'Vancouver', 'Surrey', 'Burnaby', 'Victoria').

keyword.description: Required program title or career category keyword (e.g., 'Health Care Assistant', 'HCA', 'Early Childhood Education', 'ECE', 'Electrician', 'Cybersecurity').
